response.sql: WITH status_tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM status_tallies), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT archstat AS status, tally, share, share - (SELECT value FROM avg_share) AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT value FROM avg_share);
